title: Add deterministic Console score version diffs and dual links
description:
Add deterministic score-change diff payloads for Console chat responses and render them with a dedicated inline diff component. Include both previous and updated score version links in structured audit output. Ensure behavior covers score.edit and guidelines updates through score.update while preserving existing validation/guard rails.

Definition of Done:
- Audit event carries previous/updated version links and diff payloads for changed fields.
- Console assistant message metadata stores diff payloads for UI rendering.
- Console UI renders a Monaco-based inline diff panel for code/guidelines when metadata exists.
- Targeted backend and frontend tests pass for links + diff rendering paths.
- No client-specific data is included in issue text or logs.

comments.author: ryan.porter
comments.text: Work started: implementing deterministic console score-change diffs and previous/updated score version links in runtime audit metadata + chat UI renderer. Plan includes backend audit event extension, assistant message metadata plumbing, Monaco diff component in conversation viewer, and targeted tests for score.edit + guidelines update flows.

comments.author: ryan.porter
comments.text:
Implemented deterministic Console score-change diff payloads and dual score-version links.

Backend:
- Added reusable score diff builders in execute runtime (code/guidelines entries with Monaco-ready original/modified + unified diff, truncation flags, version links).
- score.edit worker now returns version_url, parent_version_url, and diffs derived from verified persisted candidate content.
- score.update version-creating path now emits changed_fields, version links, diff payloads, and score_edit_audit compact+runtime audit event for deterministic Console handling.
- Audit compact payload now includes parent version link key (pu).
- Trace normalizer now preserves parent_version_url and structured diffs.

Procedure/UI:
- Procedure executor deterministic summary now includes both Previous/Updated score version links and non-candidate wording.
- Added score_change_audit metadata patching when updating/recording assistant messages.
- Added Console inline diff component using Monaco DiffEditor and wired it into conversation-viewer for assistant messages with score_change_audit metadata.

Tests run:
- poetry run pytest MCP/tools/tactus_runtime/execute_test.py plexus/cli/procedure/test_trace_sink.py plexus/cli/procedure/test_procedure_executor_compat.py -q (236 passed)
- npm test -- --runTestsByPath components/ui/__tests__/conversation-viewer-session-routing.test.tsx components/ui/__tests__/conversation-viewer-streaming-updates.test.tsx --watch=false (41 passed)

Notes:
- Jest run includes existing console.warn/act warnings in these suites; no test failures.
